page.layout: One printed page (right of the scan) with running text in one column; a narrow column of marginal notes at the right margin beside the text; a diagram-like brace block near the foot; running head at top; page number at top; signature/catchword line at foot. Partial text of the facing left page is at the scan's left edge and is not transcribed.

main_text.p: Mera obstinata malicia, est cum superbia, temeritate, indignatione, & huiusmodi vllis affectibus misceatur. Mat.12.31.Heb,10.26.
Hoc etiam peccatum augetur,cum in totam veritatem quæ est secundum pietatem feratur.Heb. 6.4.5.6.7.8.
main_text.head: LIBER QVARTVS. De fœdere Dei & Christo.
Cap. I.
main_text.p: ATq; hactenus de peccato,ita vt ex his & singularum imaginis Dei partium analogia,omnium peccatorum natura facillime defineri & secerni possit, modo adhibeatur in scripturarum lectione & meditatione diligentia.De fœdere Dei. cap.1.
Hactenus etiam de lapsu, prædestinationis implendæ medio communi in conditione corrupta: Sequitur de secundo, nempe Fœdere Dei.
Fœdus Dei est fœdus cum homine eiusq; femine ictum de vita & morte. Gen.2.17. & 3.15. & 17,1. Gal.3.10.11. Mar.16.16.
main_text.l: Fœderis membra sunt { actio dei stipulantis. { actio hominis stipulationem recipientis. } Rom.2.12. 26.Gen.17.1. Exod.23.8.

page.notes: The marginal note "cap.1." beside the text is printed as "cap.x." in the scan. Left edge fragments of the facing page are omitted. Some words in the diagram block are approximate; "Actio" at foot is the catchword. Several words are uncertain in the small print of the brace block.
